Rooms.Name: On the River
Rooms.Description:
The deep river flows east and west through a dense forest.  Over the
ages, the river has cut through the bedrock to form a particularly deep
channel for itself.  The banks of the river are very steep, and appear to
be very slippery, so it would be quite impossible to leave the river and
enter the forest.

Exits.Description: The river continues in this direction.

Rooms.Name: On the River
Rooms.Description:
North of here you see the miserable buildings of the poor alley. The river
flows west towards the bridge. The riverbanks are too steep to climb.

Rooms.Name: On the River
Rooms.Description:
North of here you see the dump. The river flows from east to west. The
riverbanks are too steep to climb.

Rooms.Name: On the River
Rooms.Description:
The levee is directly north of here. The river flows in an east west
direction.

Rooms.Name: On the River
Rooms.Description:
You see the warehouse on the northern riverbank. East of here you see the
city wall. The river flows west towards the levee.

Rooms.Name: On the River
Rooms.Description:
The river enters from a hole in the eastern city wall. The hole has been
blocked by several vertically positioned iron bars set into the wall.

Exits.Description:
Beyond the bars you see the great plains. With a little effort you should be
able to bend the bars aside.

Rooms.Name: On the river south of turning point
Rooms.Description:
The river flows gently west through midgaard city wall, strong iron bars
block the passage for everything except water. The river continues east.

Rooms.Name: On the river south of turning point
Rooms.Description:
The river flows gently west. To the north you can see lots of people
making their way through the turning point from or to the city of Midgaard.
The river continues to the west and to the east.

Rooms.Name: A turn in the river
Rooms.Description:
The river turns north here, making its way under a stone bridge. To the
east you can see the large castle of king Welmar. The river flows west towards
Midgaard.

Rooms.Name: Under the Stone bridge
Rooms.Description:
You are on the midgaard river under a stone bridge. On the west side of the 
bridge a ladder leads up to the road. The river continues south and north.

Rooms.Name: On the Midgaard River in the Middle of the Plains
Rooms.Description:
You are on a river flowing southwards. Around you large plains stretch far
on both sides. To the north you see a small wooden bridge across the river 
and behind it you see the Moria Mountains and to the north-east you can see 
the beginning of a large forest.

Rooms.Name: On the Midgaard river at a old bridge
Rooms.Description:
You are on a river flowing southwards, a old bridge is spanning the river
here. The river continues north and south and if you dare you can climb up
onto the bridge.

Rooms.Name: On the Midgaard River in the Middle of the Plains
Rooms.Description:
You are on a river flowing southwards. Around you large plains stretch far
on both sides. To the north you see that the river enters a cave in the Moria 
Mountains and to the east you can see a large forest.

Rooms.Name: On the river in a dark cave
Rooms.Description:
You are on a river in a dark cave in the Moria Mountains the cave
continues to the north and to the south you see some light.

Rooms.Name: At a turn in the river in a dark cave
Rooms.Description: Here the river turns to the east.

Rooms.Name: On the River
Rooms.Description:
The deep river flows east and west through a dense forest.  Over the    
ages, the river has cut through the bedrock to form a particularly deep    
channel for itself.  A small river branches off to the south, cutting a
path through the forest in that direction.

Rooms.Name: On the River
Rooms.Description:
The lush forest on the north and south banks provide a scenic backdrop
to your journey along the river.  A large tree has fallen across the river
just east of here.  The river continues to the east and west, but the banks
are too steep to climb out to the north and south.

Rooms.Name: On the River under a Fallen Tree
Rooms.Description:
A large fallen tree bridges the gap between the northern and southern
banks of the river.  The ground on either side of the river appears to be
quite marshy, probably due to recent flooding.  The swiftly flowing river
continues to the east and west, and you might be able to climb out onto
the soggy ground to the north and south.

Exits.Description:
The fallen tree is just out of reach.  Perhaps you can try climbing out of
the river onto the north or south bank.

Rooms.Name: On the River
Rooms.Description:
The river picks up speed as it flows to the west outside the city.  The
lush forest on the north and south banks provide a scenic backdrop to your
journey along the river.  A large tree has fallen across the river just
west of here, and not far to the east you can see a large stone bridge.

Rooms.Name: Under the Bridge
Rooms.Description:
The river flows under a large bridge on its journey outside of the
city.  The riverbank is too steep to climb out of the river, so you must
maintain your present path along it.  A short distance to the west you can
see the lush forest that surrounds Midgaard.  To the east, the river 
wanders past several buildings.

Rooms.Name: On the River
Rooms.Description:
The river flows past the buildings of Midgaard on its way west.  The
steep riverbanks force you to stay in the river.  A large bridge has been
built to the west, and the river continues past the rest of the city to
the east.

Rooms.Name: On the Xynarr River
Rooms.Description:
The deep brown waters of this river appear to be provided by an
underground source.  A tremendous surge of water pushes up from below, its
heat warming the murky river.  To the north is another river, and to the
east and west is a vast forest, but the banks are too steep to venture into
it. The Xynarr River continues on its way to the south.

Rooms.Name: On the Xynarr River
Rooms.Description:
The river widens considerably as it attempts to make its way through the
forest.  As it travels south, the water picks up considerable speed, and
much of the dirt that lines its route.  The resulting murky brown waters
look quite treacherous.  A vast forest of pine lines the river, but the
steep banks make it impossible to leave the river.

Rooms.Name: On the Xynarr River
Rooms.Description:
The murky brown waters of the river make their way through the vast pine
forest.  The river turns east here, deviating from its original southern
route.  A vast forest of pine lines the river, but the steep banks make it 
impossible to leave the river.

Rooms.Name: On the Xynarr River
Rooms.Description:
As the brown waters continue through the forest, the river becomes wider
and stronger.  The waters once again turn to the south, heading off to
their destination.  A vast forest of pine lines the river, but the steep
banks make it impossible to leave the river.

Rooms.Name: On the Xynarr River
Rooms.Description:
The wide brown river cuts through the vast pine forest on its way to the
south.  As it continues to its final destination, the river picks up speed,
and a considerable amount of debris.

Rooms.Name: On the Xynarr River
Rooms.Description:
The river resumes its southern path through the forest, racing to its
final destination.  As the deep brown waters rush through the woods, they
pick up various bits of debris.

Rooms.Name: On the Xynarr River
Rooms.Description:
The river once again turns, this time to the west.  The deep brown
waters rush through the forest, picking up speed as it continues on its
way.  Several branches float past you, plucked from the steep banks of the
river as it races to the west.

Rooms.Name: On the Xynarr River
Rooms.Description:
The river resumes its southern path through the forest, racing to its
final destination.  As the deep brown waters rush through the woods, they 
pick up various bits of debris.

Rooms.Name: On the Xynarr River
Rooms.Description:
As the river winds through the forest, it picks up considerable speed.
The roaring waters race past the trees, taking pieces of them along as
souvenirs.

Rooms.Name: On the Xynarr River
Rooms.Description:
The churning brown waters of the river are moving at an incredible speed
as they rush through the forest.  To the south, you see the gaping mouth of
the river, where it meets a large body of water.
